claims.claim: Direct tokumbo (used import) engine from Belgium
claims.evidence: No shipping label, customs paperwork, or country-of-origin marking visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed remotely.
Single static photo on the ground; no start-up video, no audio of running engine, no smoke/exhaust check shown.
No odometer, ECU readout, or engine-hour sticker visible; mileage cannot be read from a bare engine photo.
No close-up of bolt heads, gasket seams, or factory seals to confirm the block/head has not been disturbed.

risks.risk: Engine make/model/displacement unknown, so fitment to buyer's vehicle is unverified
risks.proof: Clear photo of the engine code/nameplate stamped on the block, or a VIN/parts-tag close-up
risks.if_unproven: priced as unidentified generic engine, lowest tier for 'engine assembly' category

risks.risk: Engine may not actually run or may have internal wear/knock despite seller's claim
risks.proof: Video of cold start-up with audible idle, revving, and visible exhaust (no excessive smoke)

risks.risk: Missing or non-functional accessories (turbo, alternator, starter, injectors, sensors)
risks.proof: Multiple-angle photos/video showing all sides of the engine with accessories attached and a parts checklist
risks.if_unproven: priced as bare block only, assuming key accessories missing or unverified

risks.risk: Hidden leaks, cracks, or corrosion not visible in the single outdoor shot
risks.proof: Close-up photos of oil pan, head gasket area, and block underside, plus a fluid-leak check after a short run
risks.if_unproven: priced as having undisclosed leak/damage risk

risks.risk: Possible accident or water-damage history not disclosed
risks.proof: Any import/customs documentation or seller-provided history report tied to the engine's serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown history, worst-case damaged

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/nameplate or stamped serial number
Video of the engine being started cold, idling, and revved with audible sound
Photos from all four sides and top/bottom showing attached accessories (turbo, alternator, starter, sensors)
Any customs/import paperwork or Belgium export documentation supporting the tokumbo claim
Close-up of head bolts/gasket seams to support 'never opened' claim
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a bare car engine assembly, so it can be priced at worst case (unidentified model, unverified running condition, unverified completeness) pending the listed proofs.
